title: Ordinary finite comparison commutes with quotient transitions
statement: For the adic coefficient datum and the fixed ordinary finite interfaces of [def-cbc-completed-reduction-finite-interfaces], let E_n(M) be completedReductionOrdinaryComparison at M and let tau_ba be completedReductionOrdinaryTransition. The actual strict tower arrow from b to a, followed by E_a(M), equals E_b(M), followed by restriction of tau_ba and the canonical composition of scalar restrictions. This holds for every completed-coefficient module M and every a <= b, including a=b.

source.place: Finite-reduction compatibility invoked for g_U; strict compatibility of ordinary finite reductions, expanded in derived_finite_quotient_coherence docstring Step 4.

proof.text: Transport the sectionwise surjectivity of the completed constant-coefficient projection through the completed and finite coefficient comparisons. The sheaf quotient unit is then an epimorphism by the ordinary quotient-unit lemma.

Use the canonical inverse-image adjunction with its normalized unit, composed with scalar extension. Its Hom equivalence evaluates a map on the completed tensor generator with scalar 1 and the inverse image of a section.

Apply the injective Hom equivalence to the required square and cancel the epimorphic quotient unit. Naturality of the strict tower unit identifies the two quotient-unit composites. On sections the normalized ordinary comparison and quotient transition each send the (1,1,m) generator to the corresponding finite generator. Restriction composition is identity on sections. These three normalized formulas prove the equality.
